scope.description: Six Haiku ego-depletion shared-memory batches using the same fixed causal explanation and 24 position-balanced speaking orders.
scope.causalStatus: descriptive cross-batch audit; not a randomized contrast
scope.traceIdentity: The source artifacts do not expose one uniform trace-hash field. Traces are identified by artifact path and run ID and validated by direct content checks.
scope.excludedExactRepeats: Seeds 202 and 303 from the 2026-10-21 content factorial are exact repeats of seed 101 and are not counted as separate batches.

batchSummaries.label: Content factorial (seed 101; two other exact repeats excluded)

savedPromptComparison.contractDifference: The saved system and user prompts match for all aligned first-neutral calls, but the older crossover used maxTokens=1024 and the confidence-display batch used maxTokens=384. They are prompt-text matched, not exact request-contract replicates.

interpretation.finding: No neutral agent endorses on its first response in any batch. Five batches have 240/240 uncertain first responses; the instruction-crossover batch instead has 232 uncertain and 8 rejecting judgments. Among the other five batches, aligned trajectories first diverge no earlier than neutral response 16, in the second round. Second-response endorsement totals then span 9 to 40, before widening to 139 to 185 at the final response. The variation therefore does not begin in the first neutral judgments. It first appears during the second response, and the between-batch range is larger by the final response.
interpretation.limit: The analysis locates the first observable divergence but cannot identify its external cause. Different execution dates and grid contexts remain confounded, and the trace databases do not store complete provider requests. A locked replay is needed to test current-provider drift.
